6.why: Source P6 opens 'move the belay to a bolt by a tree' after a short 4th-class bit: a belay at the start of the pitch, not the end of pitch 6.

8.why: Source P8: 'Setup the belay on the bolts out left to avoid pinching the rope in the large block' near pitch end.
8.text: Belay at the bolts out to the left, so the rope does not pinch behind the big wedged block.

2.why: MP P2: 'base of an obvious left-facing corner. Belay from a small tree'; trip report: step off the big tree ledge to reach the small belay tree.
2.text: A small tree at the foot of the obvious left-facing corner, reached by stepping off the big tree ledge.

3.why: MP P3: 'Climb the left-facing corner to a ledge with a tree belay'.
3.text: A comfortable ledge with a tree at the top of the left-facing corner.

4.why: MP P4: 'to a stance below a roof'; dead-end chimney nearby, not the one climbed. 'Beside' softened to 'near'.
4.text: A stance beneath the roof, near a dead-end chimney that the route does not climb.

6.why: MP P6: offwidth with jammed 2x4, 'pass two bolts to an alcove'.
6.text: An alcove reached above the offwidth, after passing the two bolts.

P11.why: Source P11 says only 'Keep following groove to easier terrain and a big ledge'; page gives no belay information for any pitch.

1.why: MP P1: climb the stair-stepped gully about 80 ft 'to an anchor at a crack'.
1.text: Stop at the top of the stair-stepped gully and build the anchor in a crack there.

2.why: MP P2 ends 'on a shelf with small pools and good belay cracks'.
2.text: The belay is on a rock shelf holding a couple of small pools, with solid cracks for anchor gear.

4-8.why: MP: aim for small stubby tree on upper right of the face, then belay at the next small tree patch.
4-8.text: Head for the stubby tree on the upper right of the face, then belay at the next patch of small trees.

1.why: Source P1 only ends 'to a flat ledge below a vertical crack' with no belay described; 'starts the second pitch' is unsupported (P2 is thin hands then left toward trees).

3.why: Source P3: after the two bolts, 'wild knobs and a finger crack for a few more meters to a bolted belay'; 'after the traverse' was wrong, corrected.
3.text: The bolted anchor sits a few metres above the two bolts, up knobs and a finger crack.

4.why: Source P4: 'finish at an anchor on a small ledge'.
4.text: The anchor sits on a small ledge at the top of the pitch.

7.why: Source P7: 'reaching a belay on a slab beneath a prominent roof system'; gear detail came from a photo caption, removed.
7.text: Belay on the slab directly beneath the prominent roof system.

8.why: Source P8: 'reach a belay stance on the ridge' after the roof's left edge; 'crest' not stated, removed.
8.text: Belay from a stance on the ridge.
